items.title: Brussels: Rioters clash with police at anti-austerity rally
items.description: Violent rioters, many of whom were masked, confronted police at the edge of an anti-austerity march in Brussels. Police responded with water cannons and tear gas.

items.title: Schools crisis in France: Investment fails to inspire confidence
items.description: For weeks, schoolchildren in France have been protesting the failing education system. Compared to many other countries, France invests heavily in education but critics say that the funds are not distributed fairly.

items.title: China, EU reach deal to 'moderate' China's car exports to EU
items.description: An agreement between the EU and China would reduce exports of Chinese electric and plug-in hybrid cars to the 27-member European bloc by up to 50%, according to the EU trade envoy.
